privacy.title: Privacy Policy and Terms of Use
privacy.dataCollectionText:
VoiceCRM collects the following data to provide the service:

- Audio recordings of your meetings
- Transcriptions generated from audio
- Contact information (name, email, phone, role, company)
- Meeting data (title, summary, date, participants)
- Tasks and decisions extracted from meetings
- Account information (name, email, encrypted password)
privacy.dataProcessingText:
Your data is processed as follows:

- Recorded audio is sent to the OpenAI API (Whisper) for automatic transcription
- The transcription is processed by artificial intelligence (GPT) to extract entities such as contacts, companies, tasks, and decisions
- Extracted data is organized and stored in your personal CRM
- AI processing occurs in real time after each recording
privacy.dataStorageText:
Your data is stored as follows:

- All data is stored in a secure PostgreSQL database
- Data remains stored as long as your account is active
- When you delete your account, all associated data is permanently removed
- Database backups are maintained for recovery in case of technical failures
privacy.userRightsText:
You have the following rights over your data:

- Access: You can view all your data at any time through the VoiceCRM dashboard
- Correction: You can edit and correct any contact, company, meeting, and task information
- Deletion: You can delete individual meetings or delete your entire account and data permanently
- Portability: Your data can be exported through the system's reporting features
privacy.dataSecurityText:
We implement the following security measures:

- Passwords are encrypted using secure hashing algorithms (scrypt)
- Session-based authentication with secure tokens
- Per-user data isolation: each user can only access their own data
- Encrypted communication via HTTPS
- Validation and sanitization of all data inputs
privacy.contactText:
To exercise your rights or clarify questions about your data, please contact us:

Email: privacy@voicecrm.app

We will respond to your request within 15 business days.
privacy.termsText:
By using VoiceCRM, you agree to the following terms:

- The service is provided for personal and professional use of customer relationship management
- You are responsible for the content of recordings and the accuracy of information entered
- Using the service for illegal or harmful activities is strictly prohibited
- We reserve the right to suspend accounts that violate these terms
- The service may undergo scheduled updates and maintenance
- We do not guarantee uninterrupted service availability
privacy.consentText:
By creating an account and using VoiceCRM, you declare that:

- You have read and understood this privacy policy and terms of use
- You consent to the collection and processing of your data as described above
- You have the right to record the meetings and conversations you register in the system
- You may withdraw your consent at any time by deleting your account

axisLanding.heroParagraph: Tell AXIS what you need — it understands, categorizes and organizes your finances, schedule, tasks and habits automatically. On the web or directly on WhatsApp.

axisLanding.dashDesc: Smart dashboard with everything you need to see in 30 seconds.
axisLanding.mod0Desc: Log expenses by voice, text, photo of receipt or PDF. AI categorizes automatically and you track where every dollar goes.
axisLanding.mod1Desc: Say the appointment and AI suggests the best time. Approve with one tap. No conflicts, no effort.
axisLanding.mod2Desc: Streaks, progress and automatic discipline score. AI evaluates your justifications and keeps you on track.
axisLanding.mod3Desc: Ask anything about your data. AI has long-term memory and full access to your context.
axisLanding.mod4Desc: Log expenses, check balance, create tasks and much more — all directly via WhatsApp. Send audio and the bot transcribes.
axisLanding.miniChatQ: How much did I spend this month?
axisLanding.miniChatA: You spent $2,340 in February. 42% was on food.
axisLanding.step0Desc: Text, voice, photo, PDF or WhatsApp. Whatever is easiest.
axisLanding.step1Desc: Classifies, categorizes and organizes in milliseconds.
axisLanding.step2Desc: Everything logged. Zero effort. Life organized.
axisLanding.faq0A: Yes! You create your account in seconds and get access to all the main features for free — finance, schedule, tasks, habits, AI chat and the WhatsApp bot. No credit card required. The idea is that you try AXIS without any barriers and feel the impact on your routine before anything else.
axisLanding.faq1A: Yes, and that's one of the coolest parts. You connect your WhatsApp to AXIS and start logging expenses, creating tasks, scheduling appointments and checking your balance — all by text or audio message. Send an audio saying "I spent $30 on Uber"? The bot transcribes, understands and logs it automatically. You don't even need to open the app to keep everything organized.
axisLanding.faq2A: Totally. Your data is encrypted and completely isolated — no one but you has access. We don't sell, share or use your data to train models. You have full control: you can export everything or delete your account and all data at any time, hassle-free.
axisLanding.faq3Q: Do I need to install an app?
axisLanding.faq3A: No installation needed. AXIS works 100% in the browser, on any device — computer, tablet or phone. Just open the website and use it. And if you prefer, the bot works directly in the WhatsApp you already have installed. No downloads, no updates, no storage space used.
axisLanding.faq4A: AXIS AI understands natural language. You speak or type however you want — "spent $50 on lunch", "meeting with John on Friday at 3pm", "I want to read 30 minutes a day" — and it categorizes, organizes and logs everything automatically. Over time, it learns your spending patterns, schedules and habits, getting more precise in its suggestions. It also evaluates your habit and task justifications using a gamified discipline score.
axisLanding.faq5Q: Can I use it by voice?
axisLanding.faq5A: Definitely. You can send audio via WhatsApp or use the microphone directly in the app. AXIS transcribes the audio in real time and interprets what you said. Also works with photos of receipts and PDF bank statements — AI reads, extracts values and categorizes each expense automatically.
axisLanding.faq6A: It's a gamification system that tracks how well you're keeping up with your tasks and habits. Completing tasks and maintaining habit streaks increases your score, while delays and ignored tasks decrease it. AI also evaluates your justifications — if you explain why you didn't do something, it can partially accept and reduce the penalty. It's a way to keep you motivated without being punitive.
axisLanding.ctaDesc: Create your account in 30 seconds. No card. No commitment. Use via browser or WhatsApp.
axisLanding.crossDesc: With AXIS Business, employees send receipts via WhatsApp and expenses appear organized in the dashboard — ready for approval and export. No spreadsheet, no lost paper.
